name: Valiant Gold Limited
summary: Valiant Gold Limited operates as an gold exploration and development company. It holds interest in the Reedy Project comprises 59 live tenements covering an area of approximately 218 square kilometers located in between Cue and Meekatharra and the Comet Project consists of four live tenements and covers an area of approximately 9 square kilometers located in the Murchison Province of the Youanmi Terrane, part of the Archaean Yilgarn Craton of Western Australia. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Perth, Australia.
